units.title: Overview of Codes and standards- Application in mechanical
topics: Introduction to Codes and Standards: o Understand the importance of codes and standards in ensuring safety
quality, and consistency in mechanical engineering practices. 2

Key Mechanical Engineering Standards: o ASME (American Society of Mechanical Engineers): Overview of its significance and applications in mechanical systems. o ASTM (American Society for Testing and Materials): Learn about its role in material testing and specifications. o ISO (International Organization for Standardization): Introduction to its global standards for mechanical engineering processes and systems
Program Name: Diploma Engineering Level: Diploma Branch: Marine Engineering Subject Code: DI01018011 Subject Name: Engineering Workshop Proficiency 3

Practical Application: o Identify real-life examples where these standards are applied in mechanical engineering. o Assign a task to prepare a brief report or presentation on one selected standard and its industrial applications
